scope: Addresses whose most recent recorded state on the USDT or USDC contract is frozen, on Ethereum and Tron.

designations.issuer_freeze: The token issuer blacklisted the address at the contract level. Observable on-chain. Not by itself a government sanction.
designations.sanctions_listed: The record additionally carries a government designation or seizure-order attribution (for example OFAC, NBCTF, a national seizure order).

notes.address_case: Ethereum addresses are published lower-cased; compare case-insensitively (EIP-55 checksum casing carries no extra identity).
notes.excluded: Addresses whose latest recorded state is unfrozen, and malformed address strings, are excluded and counted per chain.

caveat: Point-in-time snapshot. Freezes are lifted and designations are amended; verify against the token contract and the publishing authority before relying on any row.
